41535597.abstract_snippet: This is the first real-world prospective observational study of teplizumab use following approval by the United States Food and Drug Administration in individuals with stage 2 type 1 diabetes. We examined whether glycaemic responses observed in controlled trials were reproduced in real-world practic...

42119975.title: Once-Weekly Insulin Icodec: Safety Profile in Type 2 and Type 1 Diabetes Based on a Pooled Analysis of ONWARDS 1-6.
42119975.journal: Endocrine practice : official journal of the American College of Endocrinology and the American Association of Clinical Endocrinologists
42119975.authors: Bajaj HS; Andersen SB; Hristova B
42119975.abstract_snippet: To describe the safety profile of once-weekly insulin icodec (icodec), focusing on aspects beyond hypoglycemia, in a pooled population from the ONWARDS phase 3a trials.

42048049.title: Evaluating once-weekly insulin efsitora alfa for adults with type 2 diabetes.
42048049.authors: Ramachandran A; Batra J; Desouza C
42048049.abstract_snippet: This review summarizes current evidence on insulin efsitora alfa, a novel once-weekly basal insulin developed to simplify therapy in adults with diabetes. Its Fc-fusion molecular design enables a prolonged half-life and a flat pharmacokinetic profile with low variability. Data from the QWINT phase 3...

41705603.title: Cost-utility of once-weekly insulin icodec versus once-daily basal insulins for type 2 diabetes in China.
41705603.authors: Tong X; Xing C; Zhang L
41705603.abstract_snippet: To comprehensively assess the cost-utility of icodec, the first once-weekly basal insulin, at 700 and 1050 U formulations compared with once-daily basal insulin analogues in Chinese adults with type 2 diabetes within reimbursement context.

42117145.title: Limited Impact of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitors on Appetite and Body Weight: Evidence From Clinical and Rodent Studies.
42117145.authors: Lee J; Park S; Kim E
42117145.abstract_snippet: The effect of sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors on appetite and food intake remains unclear. This study investigated the effects of SGLT2 inhibitors on appetite, food craving, and body weight in patients with type 2 diabetes and diabetic rat models.

42109733.title: Cardiorenal protective effects of dapagliflozin combined with valsartan in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and hypertension: a retrospective cohort study.
42109733.abstract_snippet: Hypertension and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) interact to increase cardiorenal risk. This study evaluated the cardiorenal efficacy of dapagliflozin combined with valsartan in patients with coexisting T2DM and hypertension.

42109728.title: The impact of SGLT2 inhibitors on renal outcomes in patients with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease: systematic review and meta-analysis.
42109728.authors: Su Y; Wang W; Li H
42109728.abstract_snippet: To analyze and evaluate the impact of SGLT2 inhibitors on the renal outcomes of patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and chronic kidney disease, and to provide evidence-based basis for clinical rational treatment.

42108523.title: Dapagliflozin: Potential Role in Pediatric Cardiac Patient Care.
42108523.authors: Bitar K; Abdul Khalek J; Zareef R
42108523.abstract_snippet: Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors have demonstrated substantial cardiovascular and renal benefits in adults, including reduced heart failure events across diabetic and nondiabetic populations. However, pediatric cardiac data remain limited, and real-world use is increasing in specialized cen...

42102257.title: The Effect of Adding Dapagliflozin on Chronic Renal Allograft Dysfunction: A Randomized, Prospective, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Trial.
42102257.authors: David-Neto E; David AER; Alves B
42102257.abstract_snippet: Chronic allograft dysfunction (CAD) remains a leading cause of graft loss after kidney transplantation. Dapagliflozin (DAPA) has shown renal and cardiometabolic benefits in nontransplanted patients with chronic kidney disease. However, data on recipients with CAD are lacking.
